And when he sent with him one of the scribes of the Arabs,
and he entered into the fortress,
and spoke with them through an interpreter,
they replied,
'Our religion we will not change;
and the gold that you have demanded from us, we do not have,
but we have a great deal of silver.'
And they agreed to give three hundred elephants,
and a large quantity of silver,
and exquisite garments,
and aromatics.
And Mahmud replied,
'I agree,
provided that the king consents to put on our garment,
and to gird a sword and belt upon his loins,
and cut off the tip of his finger to confirm the oath, according to the custom of the Indians.'
For the envoy of the Arabs said:
'When I entered to the king of the Indians {OCR?},
I found him to be a handsome youth, sweet of beauty,
pleasing in his blackness.
And he was sitting upon a silver couch,
and was wearing a robe and trousers of silk {OCR?},
and upon his head was a turban.
And when I saw him, I clapped my hands together loudly,
and bowed down upon them,
according to their custom.
And I told him concerning the garment, that he should put it on.
He made many excuses and said to me,
"I beg of you to spare me from wearing it,
and tell your master
that I wore it."
And when I replied,
"It is not possible for me to act deceitfully toward my master,"
with difficulty he put it on,
and bound the belt,
and cast the sword upon his hips.
And when he was wrapped in the cloak,
I was ashamed to say to him,
"Cut off your finger;"
instead, I only said, "Swear to us."
And he answered,
"Our swearing is by the idols and by the fire,
and with you, those of yours are not accepted.
By what shall we swear to you?" But I said,
"You yourself know how you should swear to us."
Immediately he commanded a servant, and he brought him a lancet {OCR?};
and he took it in his right hand and cut off with it the tip of his left little finger,
without his complexion changing at all.
And he scattered powder upon it and bound it up.
And the piece that was cut off they washed in water,
and placed camphor with it in a pouch,
and gave it to me, along with some garments and silver and two horses.'
